en.html:
Ten Champions Member B"Hmph. Reckless. Call it youth, and it is almost charming."
Ten Champions Member C"We do the opposite. Every scheme considered. One advantage, another advantage on top of it. Only then do we fight."
Ten Champions Member D"That is why Oyumi's Ten Heroes are supreme."
Ichijou"Kya bakwaas. Your clever plan failed, that's why we're standing here! Enough speeches. Come and fight."
Inada"Heh-heh-heh...! Failed? Failure, you are calling this?"
Inada"Nothing has failed. If you'd drunk the tea, yes, the business would have finished sooner."
Kageaki"Poison..."
Inada"I wasn't expecting much from that. The real plan—starts now."

So casually she said it. No room even for misunderstanding.

Ichijou and I were to take each other's heads.

...What now?

Accept this? Impossible. No need even to think.

Refuse? Also impossible. One answer meaning no, and at least one hostage would die that instant.

Careful words. Negotiate.

No... even that was dangerous. Offer to negotiate, and their most likely answer would be to kill one hostage. Their way of refusing.

Two left after that. Enough to keep threatening us.

Three hostages. They had chosen well.

Was acceptance the only way? Two die, three survive. The arithmetic was not bad.

But Ichijou must not die. At worst, I could leave the rest to her. Give them my own head. But...

—No.

Then the Silver Star—
